title: AnalysisCommon
description: Shared primitives of the analysis result blobs (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md). This file's root is not a type; only its $defs are. All times are in seconds of the working asset (04 §1).

SecRange.description: A half-open range [startSec, endSec) in seconds of the working asset.

NumberSeries.description: A dense series of numbers, e.g. a per-hop energy curve or an embedding vector.

DrumComponent.description: A drum sub-stem produced by the deep `drum_split` stage (04 §7).

TagScore.description: One taxonomy label with the model's score in 0..1 (04 §6.2). The label vocabulary lives in the tagging model's head, not in the schema.
